intel.company_overview: Postman is an API platform that helps developers design, build, test, manage, and distribute APIs across their entire lifecycle. It is notable for being an AI-native platform now featuring an "AI Engineer" and Agent Mode, and is used by 500,000 companies including 98% of the Fortune 500, with 500k+ users and $225M+ recent funding.
intel.target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, and enterprises (Fortune 500, financial services, e-commerce, and other industries) building, testing, managing, and distributing APIs and services at scale.

intel.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source, production-grade Backend-as-a-Service built around a Postgres database, offering built-in features like Authentication, Edge Functions, Realtime data sync, Storage, and Vector embeddings. It is notable for its 'open source from day one' philosophy and its reputation as a developer-friendly alternative to platforms like Firebase.
intel.target_audience: Developers, startups, agencies, enterprise teams, and individuals (including vibe coders and beginners) building production-grade applications and AI-integrated web/mobile apps who require a scalable, portable Postgres backend.

intel.company_overview: Vapi is a platform for developers and enterprises to build, test, and deploy conversational voice AI agents, handling everything from orchestration and real-time monitoring to telephony and integrations. It is notable for its "API-native" design, sub-500ms latency, and compliance features like SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI to support enterprise-scale deployment (including a named customer, Ring, running 100% of inbound volume through the platform).
intel.target_audience: Developers and enterprises looking to build, deploy, and scale conversational voice AI agents for use cases like customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling.
